name: HUB GROUP CLASS A

priced.reason: not a repriceable fcff name or no growth supplied

devils_advocate.strongest_counter: This is the third consecutive refusal on this name and the second time I have declined to answer the question the last red team actually asked: at what price does an unauditable but functioning franchise become worth owning? The price has fallen 41.7% in 63 days and 31.6% in a year. On the TRUE share count of 61,153,510 the market capitalisation is $1.447bn and enterprise value roughly $1.55-1.60bn against $3.6-3.8bn of revenue — about 0.42x sales for an asset-heavy intermodal operator. Refusing three times in a row on identical grounds risks being a policy rather than a judgment, and the one genuinely new fact of the quarter — the Hearings Panel approving continued listing — removes the single risk that would have justified the discount.
devils_advocate.what_would_prove_it: A defensible estimate of restated earning power, which requires either the restated filings themselves or a disclosure of the cumulative cash-flow effect of the misstatement. Failing that, a clean period prepared under the new accounting that is profitable.
devils_advocate.already_visible: The listing relief is visible and it is real, but it is narrower than it reads: it is conditioned on filing by 2026-12-31, the company says it may miss that, and the absolute ceiling is 2027-03-12 — so the counter converts a delisting risk into a dated deadline rather than removing it, and in the same week the company picked up a fourth delinquency. The decisive evidence runs the other way and is already filed. First, the one period prepared outside the restated years was pre-announced as an operating LOSS, so there is no clean profitable period against which to call the price cheap. Second, and new this quarter, the controlling family removed half the board by written consent while the restatement was unfinished and the audit committee was being reconstituted; whatever the merits, an investor relying on numbers that do not yet exist is now relying on them being produced under a board the controlling holder reconstituted mid-process, and Class A carries no governance recourse. The counter fails on the price question too: at 0.42x sales the name is not obviously cheap for an operator whose current half-year is loss-making.
devils_advocate.unresolved: The cumulative cash-flow effect of the restatement, which no public document discloses and which will not exist until the delinquent filings land. Whether the restatement widens a fourth time. Whether the Hearings Panel grants the extension the company anticipates requesting, and what it does if 2027-03-12 arrives unmet. I record that I cannot size any of these rather than guessing at them.

what_changed: The observable the 2026-09-23 pass nominated has fired, and it cuts both ways. On 2026-11-11 the Nasdaq Hearings Panel approved continued listing of the Class A stock subject to the company filing ALL delinquent reports by 2026-12-31, and told the company it has no discretion to extend the exception period beyond 2027-03-12 (8-K and EX-99.1, 2026-11-17). On 2026-11-17 the company received a further non-compliance notice because the Q3 2026 10-Q was also not filed, taking the delinquent list to FOUR filings (FY2025 10-K plus Q1, Q2 and Q3 2026 10-Qs) from three. The company states in terms that it 'cannot confirm that it will be able to complete all of the Delinquent Filings on or before December 31, 2026'. Separately and not previously recorded here: on 2026-10-01 the Yeager family and related trusts, acting by WRITTEN CONSENT of a majority of combined voting power, removed three directors (Flannery, McNitt, Yablon) without cause, appointed four of their own nominees, and adopted Second Amended and Restated Bylaws; three further directors (Boosalis, Ross, Slark) then resigned the same day, so six of the prior board left in one day and the audit committee is being reconstituted mid-restatement. Still no restated or audited financial statement for any period exists.
consensus_case: At $23.67 the market is paying roughly 0.4x revenue for a functioning intermodal and logistics franchise with ~$3.6-3.8bn of revenue, ~6,000 employees and drivers, and modest net debt, on the view that the accounting problem is a bookkeeping event rather than an economic one: the understatement was of purchased transportation costs and accounts payable, which is a timing and accrual failure, not a revenue fiction, and a restated Hub Group still owns the same terminals, chassis and customer relationships. On that reading the Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision of 2026-11-11 removes the tail risk that mattered most — the shares keep their listing while the filings are completed — and the buyer is being paid a discount for illiquidity of information rather than for impairment of assets.
base_case_rationale: No base case is admissible. The FCFF base of $231.6M is the mean of fiscal 2024, 2023 and 2022, and the company has formally repudiated fiscal 2024 and 2023 through two Item 4.02 filings (2026-02-05 covering the 2025 quarters, 2026-05-12 extending the review to FY2024 and FY2023). Under the CENX refinement the question is not whether a 4.02 exists but whether an unrepudiated restated filing now covers the window; fourteen months after the first 4.02 and six months after the second, none does. The only year in the window not formally repudiated is fiscal 2022, the freight-cycle peak, when revenue was $5.34bn against $3.95bn trailing. There is therefore no year of audited, relied-upon cash flow from which to build a base, and the company pre-announced an operating LOSS for H1 2026 — the one period prepared outside the restated years and under new management.
key_risks: Four delinquent SEC filings and no audited or unrepudiated financial statement for any period; fiscal 2024 and 2023 formally repudiated by the filer itself
Nasdaq exception expires 2026-12-31 with an absolute ceiling of 2027-03-12; the company states it cannot confirm it will meet the earlier date
Operating loss pre-announced for H1 2026 — the only period prepared outside the restated years

Controlling Yeager family removed three independent directors by written consent on 2026-10-01 and appointed four nominees, mid-restatement, with the audit committee being reconstituted; Class A has no effective governance recourse
Securities litigation and SEC enforcement commonly follow a two-stage Item 4.02
Every per-share figure on the brief divides by 37,315,154 shares against an actual 61,153,510
watch_for: Filing of the FY2025 10-K with restated FY2024 and FY2023 — the first point at which any input to this model becomes usable
Whether all four delinquent filings land by 2026-12-31, and failing that whether the Hearings Panel grants an extension toward 2027-03-12
Restated operating cash flow for 2023-2024 against the $458.2M/$422.2M the engine is still using
Any fourth Item 4.02, or a widening of the restatement beyond FY2023
Q4 2026 or FY2026 operating result — the first clean profitable period would make the cheapness question answerable
